subject: Lyra Capital SIG: control answers and artifact queue
messages:
From: Emma Holt <emma.holt@lyracapital.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lyracapital.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lyra Capital - SIG questionnaire and evidence request

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lyra's security and procurement team reviewed the platform and we'd like to move forward with a formal SIG survey as part of our vendor assessment. Attached is our baseline SIG questionnaire (redacted to the sections we need answered).

Can you: 
- Provide completed answers for the attached SIG (we only need the first three sections: Org, Access Controls, Data Protection)
- Map your controls to our SIG IDs (a simple crosswalk table is fine)
- Upload or send the requested artifacts for the items flagged as "evidence required" (e.g., SOC 2 report, recent audit logs, key rotation proof)

Target timeline: responses and evidence by EOD next Thursday (2029-07-25). If that is tight, let me know what you can do.

Attachments: Lyra_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Emma Holt
Head of InfoSec Vendor Risk
Lyra Capital

On Thu, Jul 18, 2029 at 9:12 AM Emma Holt <emma.holt@lyracapital.com> wrote:

Subject: Re: Lyra Capital - SIG questionnaire and evidence request

Emma —

Appreciate the note and the file. We'll take ownership of the SIG sections you specified. Quick plan:

1) Soojin will own the control crosswalk and answer set for Access Controls / Data Protection.
2) Kim will pull the artifact bundle (SOC 2 summary, S3 access audit, key rotation logs).
3) I will review and sign-off on the final package and upload to the secure drive link you provide.

Timeline: we'll aim to return the completed SIG + artifacts by end of day 2029-07-25. If we run into evidence gaps, we'll flag those by Tuesday and propose compensating controls.

Couple quick clarifying Qs so we can prioritize:
- For SOC 2, do you require the full report PDF or is the SOC 2 Type II with bridge letter sufficient?
- For audit logs, are you looking for a sampling window (e.g., last 90 days) or a specific event set?

Looping in Soojin and Kim to confirm cadence.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher

Sean / Emma —

We started the crosswalk this morning. Summary of progress and plan below.

What we'll deliver by EOD 2029-07-25:
- Completed SIG answers for sections: Org, Access Controls, Data Protection (sheet: "Answered SIG v1").
- Control crosswalk: redwood_control_crosswalk_2029-07-18.csv (maps Lyra SIG IDs to Redwood control IDs, implementation notes, owner).
- Evidence bundle: a short evidence index + artifact files. For now the bundle will include the following artifacts: 
   * SOC 2 Type II - redacted executive summary (we will provide full report under NDA/secure link)
   * s3-access-audit-20290630.pdf (sample of object-level access events for the last quarter)
   * key-rotation-proof-20290701.pdf (KMS rotation schedule and a recent rotation entry)

Notes / clarifications: 
- SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report exec summary in the bundle. If you need the full report, we'll request an NDA and provide the full PDF via our secure evidence portal.
- Audit logs: we've included a 90-day sample for the S3 bucket used for customer artifacts. If you require broader telemetry (e.g., inference runtime access traces), let us know which timeframe.

Attachments referenced (we will upload to the shared Drive and also send copies to this thread): redwood_control_crosswalk_2029-07-18.csv, s3-access-audit-20290630.pdf, key-rotation-proof-20290701.pdf

Soojin Lee
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Thanks Sean / Soojin —

This looks good and aligns with what we asked for. A couple of quick clarifications before you finalize the bundle: 
1) SOC 2: a redacted exec summary is fine for the initial review. We'll request the full report via NDA if anything in the exec summary requires deeper review.
2) Audit logs: the S3 sample is acceptable; can you also include a short note that describes how long audit logs are retained and where (log storage location / retention policy)? That helps our legal and security teams validate retention controls.

Procurement — please confirm whether Lyra will need an internal PO or a contract upload in Coupa. We'll coordinate contract steps after the SIG review.

Looking forward to the completed package by 7/25.

Best,
Emma Holt
Head of InfoSec Vendor Risk
Lyra Capital
